title: Monsoon Session 2026 LIVE: Chaos, Sloganeering Rock Parliament, Both Houses Adjourned Till Tomorrow 11 AM
description: The Monsoon Session of Parliament is set to commence today, with the Lok Sabha scheduled to introduce The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026, besides taking up obituary references, Question Hour, papers to be laid on the Table, a ministerial statement, and other listed business, according to the Lok Sabha's List of Business.
